CHEAP PART: (*FAIL) and (*F) translate exactly to (?!) in perl-regex-to-ppcre (perlre: '(*FAIL) ... is equivalent to (?!)').  (*ACCEPT) and (*:NAME) (only observable via $REGMARK/$REGERROR) and (*SKIP)/(*PRUNE)/(*COMMIT)/(*THEN) (backtracking-control) need engine support -- a :filter cannot cut backtracking.  Measurement for the engine question: #1528 (control verbs 18 of the 311 re_tests misses).
